display.title: Episode 14: The Miracle of Toras Emes, Chapter 1 (Purim)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's Purim show: the Purim Merrymakers land in Studio 604, a new story begins about a wicked officer's plot against the Sefer Torah, and Purim songs with graggers.
display.summary_long: The Purim 5742 program. Every time Uncle Yossi tries to open the show, strange noises and laughter interrupt him, until a helicopter lands in Studio 604 and out march the Purim Merrymakers, little soldiers of Tzivos Hashem, with a jolly song and the reminder that on Purim it is a mitzvah to be happy. Story time begins a new serial: a kind king lets the Jews learn Torah freely, and they honor him by greeting him with a Sefer Torah. A jealous officer named Yivan, much like Haman, tricks Chaim the shamash into preparing an empty, make-believe Sefer Torah, planning to expose it to the king. After a young guest leads the Shema, Uncle Yossi promises that, just as in the Megillah, the plot will turn against its plotter in the next chapter. Then everyone gets out their graggers for Purim songs sung by a studio guest, Uncle Yossi phones a young listener about his picture of a boy with a siddur, and the winner of the contest is drawn.
display.lesson: On Purim it is a mitzvah to be happy, and Hashem turns the plots of the wicked against them, as He did with Haman.

date.note: 'Especially tonight, it's Purim'; episode 13 set the contest drawing for Purim, Tuesday March 9, 1982.
